items.title: Central government notifies establishment of Mediation Council of India
items.summary: The Central government has notified the establishment of Mediation Council of India (MCI) under the Mediation Act, 2023. The MCI will have its head office at Delhi. A gazette notification to that effect was issued by the government on August 27. "In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 31 of the Mediation Act, 2023 (32 of 2023), the Central Government hereby establishes a Council for the purposes of the said Act, to be called as the Mediation Council of India, which shall have its head office at Delhi," the notification said. The Mediation Act requires individuals to try and resolve civil or commercial disputes through mediation before resorting to any court or tribunal. Under the Act, the mediation process is overseen by the MCI. Its responsibilities include registering mediators and recognizing mediation service providers and mediation institutes, which are involved in training and certifying mediators. Certain disputes are deemed inappropriate for mediation such as those involving criminal prosecution or impacting the rights of third parties.
